# JMK Smart

> > JMK Smart is a wholesale manufacturer and supplier of innovative home appliances including fans, air quality solutions, smart devices, and cleaning equipment with OEM/ODM customization services.

JMK Smart specializes in manufacturing and supplying a comprehensive range of small home appliances for both retail and wholesale markets. The company offers OEM/ODM services for custom product development and manufacturing partnerships.

## Key Topics

- OEM/ODM Manufacturing
- Home Appliances
- Fan Appliances
- Air Quality Solutions
- Smart Home Devices
- Portable Fans
- Air Purifiers
- Humidifiers
- Vacuum Cleaners
- Smart Lamps
- Wearable Neck Fans
- Aroma Diffusers
- Smart Chargers
- Wholesale Manufacturer
- Small Home Appliances
